messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 8):
"""
The policyholder is entitled to transfer the credits gained to the extent of the Sum Insured, No Claim Bonus, specific waiting periods, waiting period for pre-existing disease , Moratorium period etc from the Existing Insurer to the Acquiring Insurer in the previous policy. 13) Policy/Claim cannot be contested: No policy and claim of health insurance shall be contestable on any grounds of non-disclosure and/or misrepresentation except for established fraud, after the completion of the Moratorium Period, i.e. 60 months of continuous coverage Note :The accrued credits gained under the ported and migrated policies shall be counted for the purpose of calculating the Moratorium period. 14) No Claim Bonus: The Insurer may reward the policyholders who do not make claim in the form of No Claim Bonus (NCB).
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If I have a health insurance policy with a previous insurer, can I transfer my No Claim Bonus to a new insurer when I switch plans?","answer":"Yes, the policyholder is entitled to transfer the credits gained to the extent of the Sum Insured, No Claim Bonus, specific waiting periods, waiting period for pre-existing disease, Moratorium period, etc from the Existing Insurer to the Acquiring Insurer.","facts":["policyholder is entitled to transfer the credits gained to the extent of the Sum Insured, No Claim Bonus, specific waiting periods, waiting period for pre-existing disease , Moratorium period etc from the Existing Insurer to the Acquiring Insurer"]},{"question":"After how many months of continuous coverage can a health insurance policy or claim be contested for non-disclosure or misrepresentation?","answer":"A policy or claim cannot be contested for non-disclosure or misrepresentation after the completion of the Moratorium Period, i.e., 60 months of continuous coverage.","facts":["Policy/Claim cannot be contested: No policy and claim of health insurance shall be contestable on any grounds of non-disclosure and/or misrepresentation except for established fraud, after the completion of the Moratorium Period, i.e. 60 months of continuous coverage"]}]}
